title: WaveHiTS: Wavelet-Enhanced Hierarchical Time Series Modeling for Wind Direction Nowcasting in Eastern Inner Mongolia
abstract: arXiv:2504.06532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Wind direction forecasting plays a crucial role in optimizing wind energy production, but faces significant challenges due to the circular nature of directional data, error accumulation in multi-step forecasting, and complex meteorological interactions. This paper presents a novel model, WaveHiTS, which integrates wavelet transform with Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series to address these challenges. Our approach decomposes wind direction into U-V components, applies wavelet transform to capture multi-scale frequency patterns, and utilizes a hierarchical structure to model temporal dependencies at multiple scales, effectively mitigating error propagation. Experiments conducted on real-world meteorological data from Inner Mongolia, China demonstrate that WaveHiTS significantly outperforms deep learning models (RNN, LSTM, GRU), transformer-based approaches (TFT, Informer, iTransformer), and hybrid models (EMD-LSTM).

translated_title: WaveHiTS：面向内蒙古东部风向临近预报的小波增强层次化时间序列建模
translated_abstract: 风向预报在优化风能生产中起着至关重要的作用，但由于方向数据的循环特性、多步预报中的误差累积以及复杂的气象相互作用，面临着重大挑战。本文提出了一种新颖的模型 WaveHiTS，该模型将小波变换与时间序列神经层次插值（Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series）相结合，以应对这些挑战。我们的方法将风向分解为 U-V 分量，应用小波变换捕获多尺度频率模式，并利用层次化结构对多个尺度上的时间依赖性进行建模，从而有效缓解误差传播。在中国内蒙古真实气象数据上进行的实验表明，WaveHiTS 显著优于深度学习模型（RNN、LSTM、GRU）、基于 Transformer 的方法（TFT、Informer、iTransformer）以及混合模型（EMD-LSTM）。
tldr: WaveHiTS 通过将小波变换与神经层次插值相结合，将风向分解为 U-V 分量并捕获多尺度频率模式，在中国内蒙古真实气象数据上的风向临近预报中显著优于现有深度学习和 Transformer 模型。
en_tdlr: WaveHiTS integrates wavelet transform with neural hierarchical interpolation, decomposing wind direction into U-V components and capturing multi-scale frequency patterns, significantly outperforming existing deep learning and Transformer models for wind direction nowcasting on real-world meteorological data from Inner Mongolia.
